title: FlowFix Reviewer Summary Output
description: Schema for the reviewer-summary flow output. Consumer must validate against this schema before displaying to reviewer. The human reviewer makes the final decision; this summary only accelerates review.

fact.description: Brief factual statement about the submission.

source_document.description: Filename of the document this fact was drawn from, or null.

page.description: Page number if available, or null.

review_summary.description: One paragraph for the reviewer summarizing the submission and any concerns.

needs_attention.description: true if there are issues requiring the reviewer's attention; false if the submission appears complete and consistent.
